candidates.name: Advance Auto Parts, Inc.
candidates.business: Retailer of vehicle replacement parts to DIY customers and professional garages
candidates.cause: Q2 sales of $2.00bn missed the $2.04bn expected and comparable sales fell as tight household budgets hit DIY demand, though adjusted EPS beat.
candidates.right: DIY demand must stabilise so the raised profit guidance survives a second weak quarter
candidates.wrong: Consumer spending weakens further and the long-running turnaround stalls again on falling comparable sales

candidates.name: Fabrinet
candidates.business: Contract manufacturer of optical and photonic components for networking and data centres
candidates.cause: Beat on record Q4 revenue and earnings, but negative free cash flow, heavy planned capex and flat sequential profit guidance overshadowed the result.
candidates.right: Cash generation must recover once the capex and inventory build works through
candidates.wrong: Datacom demand from its largest customers softens while margins stay under pressure
